blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: LMC INP overwrites the accumulator; STA saves the value to a mailbox.

blocks.title: Trace
blocks.text: Processes change between Ready, Running and Waiting as the OS schedules and responds to I/O.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Spooling enables multiple programs to submit print jobs without monopolising the printer.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: INP sets ACC=8; STA X writes 8 to mailbox X; the ACC remains 8. HLT ends the program.

blocks.title: Predict first
blocks.text: The process waits for disk completion, then becomes Ready for selection by the scheduler.
